result.summary: Wrote r3/lit.md for seed 804 (final round) answering the 4 literature questions in r3/analysis.md §5: (1) intraday volume-timing persistence and its second moment, (2) order-flow imbalance magnitude vs. direction, (3) non-monotonic/U-shaped exposure to nominal price, (4) separating true co-movement from scale contamination in a rolling regression beta (the G-family diagnosis). Used WebSearch extensively (WebFetch mostly failed with 403/503 on the specific PDFs tried, so findings rely on WebSearch result summaries plus cross-checks). Deliberately avoided re-citing papers already used in r1/lit.md and r2/lit.md, searching fresh angles instead. 13 sources ended up in the citation tables, all independently confirmed via search results as existing before 2023-08-08 (dates ranging 1993-2020, one corroborated indirectly via two independent conference/seminar listings rather than a confirmed SSRN date, with that caveat spelled out in the table). Several sub-questions came back empty and are recorded as "没找到" rather than guessed; one unverifiable secondary claim (asymmetric order-imbalance effect on up/down volatility) was explicitly excluded from the table per the no-fabrication rule. No code, PLAN, or other seeds' files were touched; only read PLAN.md, r3/analysis.md, r1/lit.md, r2/lit.md within the s804 directory, consistent with the role's read/write restrictions.
